latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of Free Video Generator No Credits.

- Generate, edit, and export videos or slideshows from text or images, with no per-render charges.
- Supports a wide range of media formats (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG, others up to 200MB).
- Easy cloud-based setup with automatic anonymous token generation (no account required).
- Provided clear workflows for uploading, editing, checking status/credits, and exporting finished 1080p videos.
- User-friendly error messages and actionable tips included for a smooth experience.
